correctness.rationale: At eta=zeta criticality the physical quadrant is invariant and y activity bounded; x decreases under x’=-zeta*x*(x+s*y)/(1+s*y), forcing x->0 and y->0. For r=y/x, r’=kappa*k-(kappa-q)r with q=-x’/x->0, so r->k, establishing x~1/[zeta(1+s*k)t]. Differentiation yields V=((1+s*y)/x)’=M+s(zeta-kappa)(y/x-k), M=zeta(1+s*k); hence V is exactly affine when kappa=zeta. For U=(c+d*y)/x, all-state constancy first forces eta=zeta from the y=0 1/x term, then comparing y-coefficients forces d=c*s and kappa=zeta. Off resonance delta=y-kx solves delta’+kappa delta=-k x’; stable convolution gives delta=(k*M/kappa)x²+O(x³). This yields V’=M+s*k*(zeta/kappa-1)/t+O(log t/t²), which integrates to the finite-limit log correction. Independent symbolic derivative and coefficient calculations produced exact zero residual. Finite numerics do not prove these asymptotics.
residual_risks: The asymptotic constant C depends on each initial condition; no uniform estimates in parameters claimed.
